seo_title: Semrush vs Ahrefs: API, Agency Licensing & Looker Audit (2026)
meta_description: Technical audit of Semrush vs Ahrefs for API limits, multi-seat agency scaling, and Looker Studio integration for enterprise SEO teams.
direct_verdict: Semrush wins for large-scale enterprise teams requiring deep API integration and custom reporting workflows. Ahrefs is superior for lean agencies prioritizing data accuracy and transparent, per-user seat pricing.
product_a_pros: Extensive AI visibility and prompt tracking
Dedicated account management for large teams
product_a_cons: API access is gated behind the most expensive tier
Complex add-on pricing structure for reporting
product_b_pros: Native Looker Studio integration for BI teams
Generous API unit allocation on entry-level plans
product_b_cons: Higher per-user seat cost for large agencies
hidden_gotchas: Semrush hides its most powerful API capabilities behind custom enterprise quotes, making cost forecasting difficult for mid-market firms. Ahrefs uses a three-month expiration window for PAYG credits, meaning unused API units or crawl credits vanish if not consumed quickly. Both platforms charge significant premiums for additional seats, which can inflate agency overhead by 30% annually if not managed via centralized user governance.
